examples.en: Six men have been trapped in a mine.
The men are trapped in the mine.
They must be brought to the surface soon.
examples.zh: 必须尽快把他们带到地面上来。

examples.en: The rescue operation is still going on.

examples.zh: 事实证明营救工作很困难。

examples.en: Explosives cannot be used in the mine.
Vibrations will cause the roof to collapse.
examples.zh: 震动会使矿井顶部坍塌。

examples.en: The roof of the mine may collapse.
examples.zh: 矿井的顶部可能会坍塌。

examples.en: The workers are drilling a hole.
They will bring the men up in a special capsule.
examples.zh: 他们将用特制容器把人救上来。

examples.en: There is a hard layer of rock beneath the soil.
examples.zh: 土壤下面有一层坚硬的岩石。

examples.en: The rock lies beneath the soil.
A microphone was lowered into the mine.
examples.zh: 一只麦克风被送到了矿井下。

examples.en: The men keep in touch with their relatives.
examples.zh: 被困的人与亲属保持着联系。

examples.en: The trapped men are still cheerful.
They are confident that they will get out soon.
examples.zh: 他们相信自己很快就能出来。

sentences.en: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
sentences.zh: 六个人被困在矿井里已有十七个小时了。

sentences.en: If they are not brought to the surface soon, they may lose their lives.
sentences.zh: 如果不尽快把他们带到地面上来，他们可能会丧命。

sentences.en: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
sentences.zh: 因此，营救人员正在矿井北侧钻一个孔。

sentences.en: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
sentences.zh: 他们打算用特制的容器把这些人救上来。

sentences.en: Though they are running out of food and drink, the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
sentences.zh: 虽然食物和饮水快要用完，但被困的人们情绪高涨，他们相信自己很快就会出来。

article.en: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
article.zh: 六个人被困在矿井里已有十七个小时了。

article.en: If they are not brought to the surface soon, they may lose their lives.
article.zh: 如果不尽快把他们带到地面上来，他们可能会丧命。

article.en: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
article.zh: 然而事实证明，营救工作非常困难。

article.en: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
article.zh: 如果使用炸药，震动会使矿井顶部坍塌。

article.en: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
article.zh: 因此，营救人员正在矿井北侧钻一个孔。

article.en: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
article.zh: 他们打算用特制的容器把这些人救上来。

article.en: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil, they would have completed the job in a few hours.
article.zh: 如果不是土壤下面有一层坚硬的岩石，他们几小时就能完成这项工作。

article.en: As it is, they have been drilling for sixteen hours and they still have a long way to go.
article.zh: 实际上，他们已经钻了十六个小时，而且还有很长的路要走。

article.en: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago, has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
article.zh: 与此同时，两小时前被送到井下的麦克风使被困者能与最亲近的亲属保持联系。

article.en: Though they are running out of food and drink, the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
article.zh: 虽然食物和饮水快要用完，但被困的人们情绪高涨，他们相信自己很快就会出来。
